room_description: A Japanese-style living room with tatami mats, shoji sliding doors, and traditional wooden furniture.

key_moments.description: Establishing shot of the Japanese living room.
Opening a drawer in the side table to find a set of bowls and chopsticks.
Finding a mahjong tile hidden in a potted plant.
Retrieving a pair of scissors from a low cabinet drawer.
Using the scissors to cut a patch on the sofa to reveal a hidden compartment.
Looking at a wall clock with colored hands and markers.
Setting the clock hands to specific times based on a color clue scroll.
Entering '9246' into the digital keypad on the shoji door.
Solving a slider puzzle involving multi-colored vertical pipes.
The shoji doors slide open to reveal the exit.

solution_steps: Find the scroll showing a sequence of colored hands/marks.
Manipulate the clock hands to align with these colors.
Read the numbers revealed by the clock hands (9, 2, 4, 6).
Access the sliding puzzle behind the keypad panel.
Move the colored segments up and down to align them with the corresponding colored sockets at the top.

final_action: The shoji doors slide open once the slider puzzle is completed, allowing the player to pass through.
